MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 6
   C. 8
   D. 5

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

5. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 1

   A. 1

   D. 7

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)

   D. 144

12. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21

   C. 20
   D. 9

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 15

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

16. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
